Container.Name: movienight
Container.Overview: MovieNight is the assistant for watching movies and TV series, with library preparation and data budget built-in.

Config.Name: Staging Path
Config.Description: Path for staging files before import

Config.Name: Library Path
Config.Description: Path to the media library (movies and series). Mounted in this container only.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string, REQUIRED. Format: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@movienight-db:5432/DBNAME. It must match the password set in the movienight-db template.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Session cookie signing key, REQUIRED. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Engine Secret
Config.Description: Shared secret authenticating every call to the transfer engine, REQUIRED. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. It must match the value in the movienight-transfer template.

Config.Name: Invitation TTL (hours)
Config.Description: BL-003: lifetime of a household invitation, in hours (1-720). Default 48.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: BL-003: set to 1 only when a reverse proxy sits in front of MovieNight, so x-forwarded-host is honoured. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Set to true only when the application is really served over HTTPS. The documented LAN-over-HTTP deployment needs false.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID of the container user. Match the owner of the appdata paths.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID of the container user. Match the group of the appdata paths.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Where the pre-migration backup is written. A failed backup STOPS the migration. Default: /config/backups

Config.Name: Backup Retention
Config.Description: How many pre-migration backups are kept. The oldest are pruned. Default: 5
